channel.title: The Commercial Dispatch - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Commercial Dispatch (cdispatch.com)

item.title: Trump touted bigger tax refunds this year, but Americans will likely spend them on gas
item.description: The U.S. economy was supposed to start the year with a bang, fueled by an unusually large jump in tax refunds from President Donald Trump’s tax cut legislation.

item.title: Trump says US is talking with an Iranian leader as he extends deadline for striking power plants
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday the U.S. was talking with a “respected” Iranian leader and claimed the Islamic Republic was eager for a deal to end the war.

item.title: As demand for GLP-1 pills and shots surges, healthy habits are still key
item.description: Whether they’re using weekly shots or daily pills, more Americans than ever are turning to anti-obesity drugs to lose weight and boost health.

item.title: Judge sides with New York Times in challenge to policy limiting reporters’ access to Pentagon
item.description: A federal judge agreed Friday to block the Trump administration from enforcing a policy limiting news reporters’ access to the Pentagon, agreeing with The New York Times that key portions of the new rules are unlawful.

item.title: Judge orders Voice of America be put back together again. What are the chances that will happen?
item.description: In a strongly worded decision last week, a federal judge ordered that the Voice of America — its mission to provide news for countries around the world largely shut down for the past year by the Trump administration — come roaring back to life.

item.title: Robert St. John: Nobody Plans for This
item.description: Over nearly 10 years of hosting Yonderlust tours – more than 70 trips and 1,500 people – I’ve watched the same thing happen.

item.title: Ole Miss announces college gambling center as concerns rise over addiction, athletes
item.description: The University of Mississippi on Monday announced the upcoming launch of its new Center on Collegiate Gambling, which researchers describe as the “first of its kind in the nation” amid rising national concern about betting on collegiate sports.

item.title: MSU Dining Services’ Jankowski named Aramark South Region District Manager of the Year
item.description: Mississippi State University’s Dining Services is flourishing under the leadership of James Jankowski, recently recognized as the 2025 District Manager of the Year for Aramark’s South Region.

item.title: A smarter way to satisfy a pizza craving
item.description: Some nights, around dinner time, my husband, Jon, and I will look at each other with an old familiar stare, filled with mischief and a sense of plotting – scheming even – until one of us finally breaks and asks the other, “Should we just order a pizza?”

item.title: It’s a bad time to hunt for new jobs, most US workers say in new Gallup poll
item.description: Americans’ outlook on the job market has turned increasingly pessimistic, a surprisingly negative shift given the low unemployment rate but one that likely reflects an ongoing hiring drought.

item.title: Rising receiving leaders look to build on explosive offense
item.description: Mississippi State’s offense caused problems for plenty of teams last season with explosive playmaking and an ability to stretch teams out.

item.title: Lawsuit accuses University of Alabama of censorship in ending student magazines
item.description: Students at the University of Alabama filed a federal lawsuit Monday challenging the suspension of two student-run magazines — one primarily focused on Black students and another on women’s issues

item.title: Pentagon will remove media offices after judge reinstates New York Times press credentials
item.description: The U.S. Defense Department will remove media offices from the Pentagon after a federal judge sided with The New York Times in a lawsuit challenging limits on reporters’ access to the building, a department official announced Monday.

item.title: Head coach Chase Nicholson, Starkville Academy part ways after 17 years
item.description: After a 17-year career at Starkville Academy, head football coach Chase Nicholson and the school have agreed to “part ways,” athletic director Brian Merkel confirmed to The Dispatch on Monday.

item.title: ‘Challenging’ Tenn-Tom river awaits pro anglers this week in Bassmaster Elite tourney
item.description: For the first time since 2004, Columbus is back on the circuit for the highest-level competitive bass-fishing anglers, who’ll descend on the area for a four-day showdown on the murky waters of the Tennessee-Tombigbee Waterway.
